seoTitle: For Chefs — Launch Your Food Business
seoDescription: Turn your cooking talent into a scalable food business. Zero platform fees during trial, commercial kitchen access, compliance management, weekly payouts via Stripe. Join LocalCooks in St. John's, Newfoundland.
faqQ1: How do I rent a commercial kitchen in St. John's?
faqA1: Sign up on LocalCooks, browse available commercial kitchens in St. John's, compare amenities and pricing, then book your time slot. Our platform handles scheduling, compliance, and payments.
faqQ2: What do I need to become a home-based chef in Newfoundland?
faqA2: You need a valid food handler's certificate, appropriate business registration, and access to a compliant commercial kitchen. LocalCooks helps you manage all compliance requirements including document verification and kitchen certifications.
faqQ3: How much does it cost to use LocalCooks?
faqA3: Signing up is free. Kitchen rental rates vary by facility and time slot. LocalCooks provides transparent pricing with no hidden fees. You can compare kitchens and view all costs before booking.
faqQ4: Can I list my commercial kitchen on LocalCooks?
faqA4: Yes! Kitchen owners can list their commercial kitchen facilities on LocalCooks. Apply through our kitchen manager portal at kitchen.localcooks.ca to get started with listing your space.

chefFaqQ1: How do I get paid and how much do I keep?
chefFaqA1: You keep 100% of your earnings during the trial period—we only deduct Stripe's payment processing fee (2.9% + $0.30 per transaction). Payments hit your bank account every week via direct deposit. No waiting around. No complicated calculations. You cook, customers order, money arrives.
chefFaqQ2: What does Local Cooks handle for me?
chefFaqA2: You focus on what you do best—cooking. We handle everything else. We manage customer orders, process payments securely, coordinate delivery logistics, provide ongoing platform support, and guide you through food safety regulations and certification requirements. We also partner you with verified commercial kitchens if you need them—hourly rentals, no long-term commitments. Think of us as your business operations team. You run the kitchen. We run the rest.
chefFaqA3: Most approvals happen within 24 hours. We review your food handler certification, verify your kitchen access, and get you live fast—so you can start earning as soon as possible. Your dedicated onboarding specialist will guide you through the process step-by-step and answer any questions along the way.
chefFaqQ4: Do I need a commercial kitchen?
chefFaqA4: No. You can cook from your licensed home kitchen or rent one of our partner commercial kitchens by the hour. Choose what works for you—no long-term commitments, no hidden fees. We'll guide you through the certification requirements for your setup and help you understand local food safety regulations so you launch with confidence.
chefFaqA5: Your trial is your risk-free window to test the platform without any pressure. You keep 100% of your sales (minus Stripe's processing fee only—zero platform fees). No contracts. No commitments. No strings attached. Use this time to build your menu, connect with your first customers, understand how the platform works, and see if it's the right fit for your culinary business. If it's not, walk away anytime with no penalties.
chefFaqA6: Yes. Set your own hours, take orders when you want, and pause your availability anytime. Local Cooks works around your schedule—whether you're doing this full-time or alongside other work. Many of our chefs use Local Cooks as a side income stream or test their menu before going full-time. It's completely flexible.
chefFaqA7: Yes. No contracts. No penalties. No minimum commitment. Pause your profile, take a break, or delete it entirely—your choice, anytime. Your culinary business is yours to control.
chefFaqQ8: Can I set my own menu and prices?
chefFaqA8: Completely. You have full control over your menu, pricing, and availability. Add dishes, remove dishes, adjust prices, update descriptions—all on your terms. Change things anytime based on what your customers love, what's in season, or what you feel like cooking.

vidBasics1Desc: Most of the food poisoning problems we see in our kitchens are caused by food. But it is easy to win the fight against food poisoning and other diseases and to serve food and drinks from the kitchen without food safety problems. Want to know how to win? Watch the videos in this course!
vidBasics2Desc: The practice of HACCP has its analysis and critical control points and gives you seven principles that helps you keeping your food safe.
vidBasics3Desc: Learn how to simplify the food processes in your kitchen.
vidBasics4Desc: It is very important that all employees follow the rules of personal hygiene. Learn how you can avoid bad bacteria coming into your kitchen.
vidBasics5Desc: Let's start thinking about delivery of goods to your kitchen. An important part of food safety is choosing a good supplier.
vidBasics6Desc: Food safety also includes storage, because each product requires their own way of storaging.
vidBasics7Desc: It is time to wash your hands! Preparation time is important for food safety.
vidBasics8Desc: Sometimes you need to prepare food before the customer is ordering. Learn what steps we must take to keep this food safe.

vidBasics11Desc: There is always a lot of waste we have after a service. This waste contains a lot of bacteria.
vidBasics12Desc: Following the steps in this video is very important and helps you to keep your kitchen clean.
vidBasics13Desc: Every thing we see is very important and needs to be recorded. Make sure HACCP is in place.

sellerApp_certFslQuestion: Do you have a Food Safety License?
sellerApp_certFslHelp: Typically a 5-hour SkillsPass NL course, or another provincially accepted food handler certificate.
sellerApp_certFecSub: Required for operating a food business.
sellerApp_certFecQuestion: Do you have a Food Establishment Certificate?
sellerApp_certFecHelp: Issued after an Environmental Health inspection of your prep area. We can help you find a certified kitchen.
sellerApp_certNotesDesc: Optional. Share questions or anything else we should know.
sellerApp_certNotesPlaceholder: Any other information you'd like to share or questions you have?
sellerApp_certHelpBody: Don't worry if you don't have certifications yet. We can guide you through the process once you're approved.
sellerApp_certHelpTip: 💡 If you have documents, you can upload files directly or provide cloud storage links (Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.)
sellerApp_foodSafetyQuestion: Do you have a Food Safety License?*
sellerApp_uploadFoodSafetyTip: Select a clear photo or scan of your Food Safety License certificate.
sellerApp_cloudStorageTip: Provide a shareable link from Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, etc. Make sure the link allows public viewing.
sellerApp_foodSafetyInfo: The Food Safety License is typically obtained through a 5 hours course offered by SkillPass NL or other accepted food safety certification providers by the provincial government. It teaches proper food handling, storage, and preparation methods to prevent foodborne illness.
sellerApp_foodEstDesc: Required for operating a food business
sellerApp_foodEstQuestion: Do you have a Food Establishment Certificate?*
sellerApp_uploadFoodEstTip: Upload your Food Establishment Certificate to speed up the verification process.
sellerApp_foodEstUrlTip: Provide a shareable link to your Food Establishment Certificate. This helps us verify your business setup faster.
sellerApp_foodEstInfo: This certificate is issued by Environmental Health Services after inspecting your food preparation area. It ensures your kitchen meets health and safety standards. We have relationships with commercial kitchens if you need a certified space.
sellerApp_feedbackDesc: Optional: Share any questions or additional information
